categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in semiconductor wafer processing services, focusing on wafer reclaiming and wafer thinning processes. Its end products serve semiconductor wafer manufacturing, consumer electronics, industrial electronics, and automotive electronic components. The company also develops specialized wafers for advanced semiconductor processes and biomedical detection chips.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include high-purity wafer surface treatment, wafer thinning, and advanced reclaim wafer manufacturing suitable for 2nm processes. The company employs automated, lights-out smart manufacturing with proprietary CMP and AOI equipment development. It also integrates chemical mechanical polishing, wafer grinding, metal deposition, and testing processes to provide turnkey solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major international semiconductor foundries, IDM manufacturers, and IC design companies, primarily located in Taiwan and Asia. The end markets include AI servers, high-performance computing, automotive electronics, power management ICs, and consumer electronics. The company holds a significant market share supplying wafers for advanced semiconductor manufacturing and testing.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are mainly concentrated in Taiwan, with manufacturing facilities in Hsinchu Science Park and Taichung. Export markets include Asia and the Americas, with growing sales presence in these regions. The company is evaluating potential local production in the United States to align with geopolitical trends and customer supply chain localization.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, providing wafer reclaiming and thinning services that support upstream wafer fabrication and downstream packaging and testing. It acts as a specialized foundry service provider within the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing reclaim wafer technology for 2nm and beyond, developing high-specification carrier wafers for logic, advanced packaging, and memory 3D packaging. The company emphasizes smart manufacturing automation, green production, and sustainability initiatives. R&D also targets microfluidic biomedical chips and customized detection systems, with ongoing collaborations with academic and industry partners.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through contract manufacturing services for semiconductor wafer reclaiming and thinning. The company earns income from product sales of processed wafers and related testing services, with additional revenue from licensing proprietary technologies and equipment co-development with strategic partners.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Taiwanese firms such as RS Tech, China Abrasives, and Qibond Technology, as well as emerging Chinese foundries like AVIC Semiconductor and HH Grace. The company holds a leading position in Taiwan’s reclaim wafer market with approximately 55-60% share for 12-inch wafers and about 20% share in wafer thinning. It differentiates through advanced technology, automation, and close customer partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenues of approximately NT$3.55 billion, marking a 6.73% year-over-year growth and setting a new historical high for four consecutive years. Operating profit surged by 133.05% to NT$535 million. The company maintains a solid financial structure with total assets around NT$9.56 billion and equity of NT$4.12 billion, supported by ongoing capital investments and stable cash flows.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-purity, cost-effective reclaim wafers and advanced wafer thinning solutions tailored for cutting-edge semiconductor processes. Its fully automated, lights-out manufacturing facilities provide superior yield and efficiency. Strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and integrated turnkey services enable it to meet stringent customer quality and delivery requirements, reinforcing its competitive advantage in a niche midstream semiconductor market.
